title: Gears of War: E-Day hit by a DDoS attack ⚠️
subject: gearsofwar
description:
Did you get disconnected this weekend? 👇

The Coalition confirmed on October 12 that Gears of War: E-Day's online services were targeted by DDoS attacks, causing intermittent disconnects, login issues and other service disruptions. The team says it is monitoring and mitigating the activity. Gears of War: E-Day launched October 6, 2026 on Xbox Series X|S and PC.

Sources: The Coalition / Gears of War on X (Oct 12, 2026), VGC, Pure Xbox, Xbox Wire
Game footage © Microsoft / Xbox Game Studios.

scenes.text: Gears of War: E-Day was hit by a DDoS attack.
Over the weekend, players struggled to connect to multiplayer matches, and some got dropped mid-game.
On October 12, The Coalition confirmed that DDoS attacks were targeting the game's online services.
It said players faced intermittent disconnects, login issues and other service disruptions.
The team says it is still monitoring and fighting the attacks, and will share updates if anything major changes.
E-Day launched October 6 on Xbox Series X|S and PC.
